# Interactive Brokers LLC

> Global trading platform offering comprehensive brokerage services, trading technology, and account solutions for individual traders, institutional investors, advisors, and specialized market participants.

Interactive Brokers provides multi-asset trading across stocks, options, futures, forex, bonds, and cryptocurrencies with advanced platforms like IBKR Pro and Lite. The platform serves diverse client types from retail traders to institutional firms, family offices, and hedge funds, along with specialized products like IBKR ForecastTrader for yes-or-no forecast contracts.
